newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyushu Oil to build 149,000-kw power plant.
newsitem.headline: Kyushu Oil to build 149,000-kw power plant.

text.p: Kyushu Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would construct a 149,000-kilowatt (kw) power plant at a cost of 25 billion yen to supply electricity to Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc.

The oil company was awarded a contract to supply Kyushu Electric with 137,000 kw of electricity under the independent power producer (IPP) scheme, a Kyushu Oil spokesman said. The electricity will be provided over a 15-year contract starting from April 1999.
The power plant, which is due to be completed in October 1998, will run on residual oil, the spokesman said.
It will be built in Oita on southern Japan's island of Kyushu.
